  - February: 28 days (2023 is not a leap year)
  - March: 31 days
  - April: 30 days
  - May 1 to May 11: 11 days

11 (January) + 28 (February) + 31 (March) + 30 (April) + 11 (May) = 11 + 28 + 31 + 30 + 11 = 111 days
